preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner.
A victim account must hold a non-zero balance of the contract token.

exploit_hint: The contract owner can prevent any user from transferring their tokens. First, the owner should call `setMarketinWalleAddress` to set the marketing wallet address (`________`) to their own address. Then, using this new privilege, the owner can call the `qwidji` function to add any token holder's address to a blacklist (`_________` mapping), which will cause all their future transfer attempts to revert.
